facts.claim: K J Somaiya College of Engineering was established in 1983 as a leading institute of Somaiya Vidyavihar University in Mumbai.
facts.quote: Established in 1983, K J Somaiya College of Engineering is a leading Engineering Institute of Somaiya Vidyavihar University, situated at the heart of Mumbai

facts.claim: The institution successfully launched the satellite Somaiya BeliefSat-0 by ISRO on January 01, 2024.
facts.quote: successful launch of satellite Somaiya BeliefSat-0 by ISRO on January 01, 2024 from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre
